verdict.rationale: Mercury markets team card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions. Its Cards API changelog documents managing spending limits and card lifecycle states programmatically. A long-time customer independently reports creating hundreds of virtual cards with individual limits, which corroborates per-card limits. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what the 'granular controls' include (e.g. merchant/category restrictions, limit periods), and explicit evidence of assigning cards and limits to individual employees rather than only by purpose.
